title: School of Engineering Scholarship
institution: The University of Manchester, School of Engineering
about: University of Manchester PhD scholarship tied to advertised projects in aerospace, chemical, civil, electrical and electronic, and mechanical engineering and computer science. Round two closes 15 January 2027 for PhDs starting September 2027.
requirements: First Class or 2:1 UK honours degree or international equivalent
